title: Photographing People in Tanzania: Ask First
excerpt: In Tanzania, always ask before you photograph someone. Why it matters and how to do it politely.
body:
## Ask first

Always ask permission before photographing people. A simple "Naweza kupiga picha?" (May I take a photo?) helps. See [Swahili phrases](/blog/swahili-phrases-for-safari/).

## Accept a no

Some people do not want to be photographed, for personal, cultural or religious reasons.

## Payment

Some people ask for money in return. Decide beforehand how you handle that, or ask your guide.

## Children

Ask parents first. Avoid photos of children in vulnerable situations.

## Sensitive places

Do not photograph government buildings, military sites, police or airports.

## Share

Show people the photo. It often leads to a smile and a conversation.

## Zanzibar

Be extra careful in Stone Town and villages, especially with women.
